question: 总订单数是多少
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 订单总数 FROM orders

question: 平台总收入是多少（不含退款订单）
sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS 总收入 FROM orders WHERE status != '已退款'

question: 各订单状态分别有多少订单
sql: SELECT status AS 订单状态, COUNT(*) AS 订单数 FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY 订单数 DESC

question: 2024年总收入的多少
sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS 年度收入 FROM orders WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND status != '已退款'

question: 2025年第一季度的总收入
sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS q1收入 FROM orders WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01' AND status != '已退款'

question: 2024年下半年每个月的订单量
sql: SELECT strftime(created_at, '%Y-%m') AS 月份, COUNT(*) AS 订单数 FROM orders WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2024-07-01' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' GROUP BY 月份 ORDER BY 月份

question: 每月的订单量和收入趋势
sql: SELECT strftime(created_at, '%Y-%m') AS 月份, COUNT(*) AS 订单数, SUM(amount) AS 收入 FROM orders WHERE status != '已退款' GROUP BY 月份 ORDER BY 月份

question: 退款订单占总订单的比例是多少
sql: SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN status = '已退款' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS 退款占比 FROM orders

question: 每个月的退款订单数
sql: SELECT strftime(created_at, '%Y-%m') AS 月份, COUNT(*) AS 退款订单数 FROM orders WHERE status = '已退款' GROUP BY 月份 ORDER BY 月份

question: 订单量最多的10个城市
sql: SELECT u.city AS 城市, COUNT(*) AS 订单数 FROM orders o JOIN users u ON u.user_id = o.user_id GROUP BY u.city ORDER BY 订单数 DESC LIMIT 10

question: 收入最高的10个城市
sql: SELECT u.city AS 城市, SUM(o.amount) AS 收入 FROM orders o JOIN users u ON u.user_id = o.user_id WHERE o.status != '已退款' GROUP BY u.city ORDER BY 收入 DESC LIMIT 10

question: 各城市的平均客单价排名前5
sql: SELECT u.city AS 城市, AVG(o.amount) AS 平均客单价 FROM orders o JOIN users u ON u.user_id = o.user_id WHERE o.status != '已退款' GROUP BY u.city ORDER BY 平均客单价 DESC LIMIT 5

question: 平台平均客单价是多少
sql: SELECT AVG(amount) AS 平均客单价 FROM orders WHERE status != '已退款'

question: 销量最高的10个商品
sql: SELECT p.name AS 商品名, SUM(oi.quantity) AS 总销量 FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY 总销量 DESC LIMIT 10

question: 收入最高的10个商品
sql: SELECT p.name AS 商品名, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS 销售额 FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY 销售额 DESC LIMIT 10

question: 各品类的销售收入排名
sql: SELECT c.name AS 品类, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS 销售额 FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY 销售额 DESC

question: 手机数码品类每个月的收入趋势
sql: SELECT strftime(o.created_at, '%Y-%m') AS 月份, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS 销售额 FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE c.name = '手机数码' AND o.status != '已退款' GROUP BY 月份 ORDER BY 月份

question: 每个品类有多少种商品
sql: SELECT c.name AS 品类, COUNT(*) AS 商品数 FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY 商品数 DESC

question: 价格超过1000元的商品有多少个
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 商品数 FROM products WHERE price > 1000

question: 库存最少的10个商品
sql: SELECT name AS 商品名, stock AS 库存 FROM products ORDER BY stock ASC LIMIT 10

question: 家用电器的空调平均定价是多少
sql: SELECT AVG(p.price) AS 空调均价 FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id WHERE c.name = '家用电器' AND p.name LIKE '%空调%'

question: 男女用户的订单量对比
sql: SELECT u.gender AS 性别, COUNT(*) AS 订单数 FROM orders o JOIN users u ON u.user_id = o.user_id GROUP BY u.gender

question: 各城市的用户数
sql: SELECT city AS 城市, COUNT(*) AS 用户数 FROM users GROUP BY city ORDER BY 用户数 DESC

question: 2024年注册的新用户有多少
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 新用户数 FROM users WHERE registered_at >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND registered_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'

question: 每月新增注册用户数
sql: SELECT strftime(registered_at, '%Y-%m') AS 月份, COUNT(*) AS 新增用户 FROM users GROUP BY 月份 ORDER BY 月份

question: 下单次数达到2次及以上的用户有多少
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 复购用户数 FROM (SELECT user_id FROM orders GROUP BY user_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2)

question: 有多少用户从来没有下过单
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 未下单用户数 FROM users WHERE user_id NOT IN (SELECT user_id FROM orders)

question: 平均每个订单包含几件商品
sql: SELECT SUM(quantity) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS 每单平均件数 FROM order_items

question: 订单金额在100元以下的订单有多少
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 低额订单数 FROM orders WHERE amount < 100

question: 消费金额最高的10位用户
sql: SELECT u.name AS 用户名, u.city AS 城市, SUM(o.amount) AS 消费总额 FROM orders o JOIN users u ON u.user_id = o.user_id WHERE o.status != '已退款' GROUP BY u.name, u.city ORDER BY 消费总额 DESC LIMIT 10

question: 周末和工作日的订单量对比
sql: SELECT CASE WHEN EXTRACT(dow FROM created_at) IN (0, 6) THEN '周末' ELSE '工作日' END AS 日期类型, COUNT(*) AS 订单数 FROM orders GROUP BY 日期类型

question: 2025年8月每天的订单量
sql: SELECT strftime(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS 日期, COUNT(*) AS 订单数 FROM orders WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-08-01' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-09-01' GROUP BY 日期 ORDER BY 日期

question: 成交单价低于商品定价的明细有多少条
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 促销明细数 FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE oi.unit_price < p.price

question: 购买过手机类商品的用户有多少
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.user_id) AS 购买用户数 FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%手机%'

question: 已完成订单的占比是多少
sql: SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN status = '已完成' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS 完成占比 FROM orders

question: 各季度的收入对比
sql: SELECT EXTRACT(year FROM created_at) AS 年份, EXTRACT(quarter FROM created_at) AS 季度, SUM(amount) AS 收入 FROM orders WHERE status != '已退款' GROUP BY 年份, 季度 ORDER BY 年份, 季度

question: 每个月的平均订单金额
sql: SELECT strftime(created_at, '%Y-%m') AS 月份, AVG(amount) AS 平均订单金额 FROM orders WHERE status != '已退款' GROUP BY 月份 ORDER BY 月份

question: 价格在100到500元之间的商品数量
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 商品数 FROM products WHERE price BETWEEN 100 AND 500

question: 下过订单的用户总数
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS 下单用户数 FROM orders

question: 哪个城市的收入最高
sql: SELECT u.city AS 城市, SUM(o.amount) AS 收入 FROM orders o JOIN users u ON u.user_id = o.user_id WHERE o.status != '已退款' GROUP BY u.city ORDER BY 收入 DESC LIMIT 1
